disclaimer: UX exploration only. Changes stay in memory; no real system writes.
intro: Manage the basics and teams in your organization.
existing: Existing pages • each page applies its own permissions
calendarLater: Business hours and holidays are planned for a later phase.
orgDesc: Display name and defaults for people without personal preferences.
name: Organization display name
nameHint: 2–120 UTF-16 units • does not change the slug or login branding
effective: New defaults apply on the next page load or sign-in. Personal preferences take priority.
missing: Organization defaults are unset; system fallbacks apply. Choose both language and timezone for the first save.
teamHint: 1–80 UTF-16 units • unique including inactive teams; case-sensitive
guard: Deactivation requires no current references or unfinished work; checked again when saving.
blocked: Cannot deactivate: users, queues, skills, grants or unfinished work still reference this team.
noRefs: No current references in this fixture
kept: Inactive teams retain their UUID and history. Reactivation is outside this slice.
emptyDesc: Create a team to start organizing your tenant.
readonly: Read only: supervisors see only their own team.
narrow: Narrow screens are read only. Use a desktop to edit.
forbidden: You do not have access to organization settings
forbiddenDesc: Ask an operator to check your active user and verified identity proof. Menu visibility does not grant access.
failed: Could not load data. Your draft is still on this page.
saved: Saved value read back — simulation only
noop: No change. Revision kept; simulated command receipt available.
validation: Check the name and required defaults. Nothing has been saved.
duplicate: A team with this exact name already exists, including inactive teams.
conflict: Someone changed this resource. Your draft remains. Load the latest value and review before saving again.
compare: Latest value loaded. Compare your draft with the value below before saving again.
busy: A related write is busy. No save completed; retry when available.
unknown: Outcome is unknown. Draft retained. Check the original command before starting another.
notFound: No receipt yet. This does not prove failure; keep checking the original command.
readbackFailed: Command committed, but readback failed. Verify the same result before reporting success.
reauth: Session expired. Draft remains on this page; sign in again to recheck access.
unsavedBody: There is an unsaved draft. Leaving this view discards it.
confirmTeamBody: Keeps the team and its history, and disallows new references. The real system must recheck guards at commit.
reviewDesc: Saves directly; no publish or approval step.
teamsSummary: Browse, create, rename and safely deactivate teams
noNewRights: Each linked page enforces its own permissions. Grouping adds no access.
selectItem: Select an item to view or edit
auditBoundary: Actual changes create audit records • no generic audit viewer in this slice
currentDefaults: This session keeps its current defaults until the next load.
